theme_central: Gratitude (shukr) attracts blessings, ingratitude (kufr) attracts punishment — illustrated by the account of Musa and Ibrahim's prayer for Mecca.
sources_note: Division into 7 sections precisely sourced (iqra-quran.com / bayan-ul-quran.com), small boundary adjustments (16-18, 27, 31) to cover the full 52 verses without gaps.

branches.title: Opening
branches.resume: The Book revealed to bring humanity out of darkness into light.

children.t: The Book to bring people out of darkness into light

branches.title: Consolation of the Prophet, the example of Musa
branches.resume: Every messenger sent in the language of his people; gratitude (shukr) and ingratitude (kufr).

children.t: Every messenger speaks his people's language; Musa reminds his people to be grateful

branches.title: Allah's Oneness and power
branches.resume: Rejection of the messengers by ancient peoples, warning, the failure of those who oppose Allah.

children.t: Rejection of the messengers by Nuh, 'Ad and the following peoples
The fate of those who oppose Allah, their deeds reduced to ashes

branches.title: Day of Judgment, the good word
branches.resume: Dispute between followers and leaders, Satan disowns them, parable of the good and the bad word.

children.t: Dispute between followers and leaders, Satan disowns them
Parable of the good word (a firm tree) and the bad word (an uprooted tree)

branches.title: Allah's blessings
branches.resume: Call to worship and gratitude, those who exchange Allah's blessing for disbelief.

children.t: Allah's blessings, those who exchange them for disbelief

branches.title: Ibrahim's prayer for Mecca
branches.resume: Ibrahim settles his descendants near the Kaaba and prays for the safety and piety of the place.

children.t: Blessings enumerated (heavenly bodies, rivers, day and night); Ibrahim settles his descendants in Mecca
Ibrahim's supplication for the piety of his descendants and his parents

branches.title: Closing: justice delayed, not forgotten
branches.resume: Do not think Allah unaware of injustice; this Qur'an is a reminder addressed to all of humanity.

children.t: Allah is never unaware of injustice, even when delayed
Closing: this Qur'an is a reminder addressed to all of humanity
